skill.summary: Convert slide images, screenshots, scanned PDFs, and image-only PPT/PPTX files into high-fidelity object-level editable PowerPoint, including semantic-region mixed reconstruction, measured flowcharts and knowledge graphs, native circle nodes and connectors, single-object thin and filled arrows, speaker-note preservation, and rendered QA. Use for 图片转可编辑PPT、截图还原PPT、扫描PDF恢复、图片型PPTX转换、流程图/知识图谱/复合图形/箭头重建; not for authoring a new deck from notes.
